newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Aug cumulative PSBR edges higher.
newsitem.headline: Italy Aug cumulative PSBR edges higher.

text.p: Italy's cumulative public sector borrowing requirement was 69.881 trillion lire at end-August 1996 compared with 67.295 trillion in August 1995, the Treasury Ministry said in a statement.

Receipts totalled 343.255 trillion lire over the period against expenditure of 397.408 trillion, but this gap was partially widened by a net deficit on Treasury management operations of 15.728 trillion.
Medium- and long-term domestic borrowing over the period raised 93.814 trillion, while 7.69 trillion was raised on international markets.
The volume of short-term Treasury bills in circulation fell 11.441 trillion lire to 400.573 trillion at end-August from 412.014 trillion at end-December 1995. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
